name: FLA_PAYMENT_TAXES_INT
description: FLA_PAYMENT_TAXES_INT contains the tax details of upfront tax rates and recovery tax rates for the payment.

columns.name: INTERFACE_PAYMENT_TAX_ID
columns.description: Interface Payment tax identifier. This column consistutes primary key along with LOAD_REQUEST_ID column of the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Indicates Payment number for which the taxes are being created or amended.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: INTERFACE_PAYMENT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Interface Payment header identifier from FLA_PAYMENT_HEADERS_INT table.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Interface Lease identifier from FLA_LEASES_INT table.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Tax rate code. Indicates the tax rate code selected.

columns.name: TAX_RATE_EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Tax rate effectivity from date.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction code for which this rate is defined.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_NAME
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction name selected.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for the tax rate.

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax for which the rate is defined.

columns.name: RECOVERY_TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Recovery tax rate code. Indicates the recovery tax rate code selected.

columns.name: RECOVERY_RATE_EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Recovery tax rate effectivity from date.

columns.name: RECOVERY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Recovery type code for which this recovery rate is defined.

columns.name: RECOVERY_TAX_ROU_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the recoverable portion of tax  is to be included in Right of Use or not.

columns.name: TAX_DETERMINANTS_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Source of the tax determinants when the payment is invoiced. Values can be Setup and Payment.

columns.name: NON_RECOVERY_TAX_ROU_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the nonrecoverable portion of the tax is to be included in Right of Use or not.

columns.name: CALC_TAX_ON_INCREASE_AMT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment increase agreement amounts have to included in the tax calculation.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: AMEND_ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Amend action type which identifies which action is being performed. Values could be INSERT and UPDATE.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TAX_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment tax line number. This is generated by system using a document sequence.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
